    local scale = math.clamp(screenSize.X / 1200, 0.8, 1.2)
    uiScale.Scale = scale
end

updateAutoScaling()
camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateAutoScaling)

local dragging, dragStart, startPos

topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.AbsolutePosition
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local absSize = mainFrame.AbsoluteSize
        
        -- Perhitungan posisi bebas tanpa batas layar agar tidak ngebug/getar
        local newX = startPos.X + delta.X
        local newY = startPos.Y + delta.Y
        
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
            0, newX + (absSize.X * mainFrame.AnchorPoint.X), 
            0, newY + (absSize.Y * mainFrame.AnchorPoint.Y)
        )
    end
end)

        footerFrame.Visible = true
        titleLabel.Text = "📸Say Cheese Unlock Endings"
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 480)
    end
end)

-- Fungsi Pembuatan Tombol Ending
local function createButton(endingName, endingId)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Parent = scrollFrame
    
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    
    local alreadyUnlocked = false
    if Save and Save.has then
        alreadyUnlocked = Save.has(endingId)
    end
    
    if alreadyUnlocked then
        btn.Text = "Done " .. endingName
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    else
        btn.Text = "Unlock: " .. endingName
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        pcall(function()
            unlockEvent:FireServer(endingId)
        end)
        btn.Text = "Done " .. endingName
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
    end)
end

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Terrain = workspace.Terrain
local UserGameSettings = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")

local saved = {
    effects = {},
    materials = {},
    textures = {}
}

local function restoreEffects()
    for obj, state in pairs(saved.effects) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                obj.Enabled = state
            end)
        end
    end
    table.clear(saved.effects)
end

-- ANTI LAG
AntiTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Anti Lag",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        if value then
            for _, obj in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                or obj:IsA("Trail")
                or obj:IsA("Beam")
                or obj:IsA("Fire")
                or obj:IsA("Smoke")
                or obj:IsA("Sparkles")
                or obj:IsA("PostEffect") then

                    saved.effects[obj] = obj.Enabled

                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Enabled = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        else
            restoreEffects()
        end
    end
})

-- LOW GRAPHICS
AntiTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Low Graphics",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        if value then
            table.clear(saved.materials)

            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    saved.materials[obj] = {
                        obj.Material,
                        obj.Reflectance
                    }

                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                        obj.Reflectance = 0
                    end)
                end
            end
        else
            for obj, state in pairs(saved.materials) do
                if obj and obj.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Material = state[1]
                        obj.Reflectance = state[2]
                    end)
                end
            end

            table.clear(saved.materials)
        end
    end
})

        if value then

        end

})

            end
        else

                if obj and obj.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Transparency = state
                    end)
                end
            end

            table.clear(saved.textures)
        end
    end
})

scripts.title: OP Kill All
scripts.author: band
scripts.summary: hold your gun and it should instantly kill everyone
scripts.code:
--- hold your gun and it will instantly kill everyone

local P = game:GetService("Players")
local LP = P.LocalPlayer
local E = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ACS_Engine").Events

local s, id = pcall(E.AcessId.InvokeServer, E.AcessId, LP.UserId)
if not s or not id then return end
local token = tostring(id) .. "-" .. LP.UserId

while task.wait(0.15) do
    local c = LP.Character
    local t = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if t and t:FindFirstChild("ACS_Settings") then
        local cfg = require(t.ACS_Settings)
        local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if r then
            for _, v in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
                if v ~= LP and v.Team and v.Team.Name ~= "Lobby" and v.Team ~= LP.Team then
                    local vc = v.Character
                    local h = vc and vc:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local hum = vc and vc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if h and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        local mag = (r.Position - h.Position).Magnitude
                        local cam = CFrame.lookAt(r.Position, h.Position)
                        task.spawn(function()
                            pcall(function()
                                E.Atirar:FireServer(t, false, false, cam, os.clock())
                                task.wait(0.05)
                                E.Damage:InvokeServer(t, hum, mag, 1, cfg, {ZoomValue=70,Zoom2Value=70,AimRM=1,SpreadRM=1,DamageMod=1,minDamageMod=1,MinRecoilPower=1,MaxRecoilPower=1,RecoilPowerStepAmount=1,MinSpread=1,MaxSpread=1,AimInaccuracyStepAmount=1,AimInaccuracyDecrease=1,WalkMult=1,adsTime=1,MuzzleVelocity=1,camRecoilMod={RecoilTilt=1,RecoilUp=1,RecoilLeft=1,RecoilRight=1},gunRecoilMod={RecoilUp=1,RecoilTilt=1,RecoilLeft=1,RecoilRight=1}}, nil, nil, token)
                            end)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
